name: nexus-starship-guardians
description: Project-scoped Guardian operations, live mission planning, approvals, integration readiness guidance, and verified runtime workflows for Nexus Starship Guardians.

interface.longDescription: Plan, operate, and review project-scoped Nexus Starship Guardians workflows. Supports live mission classification, capability mapping, permission-safe Guardian routing, project onboarding, bounded Guardian runs through the compatible REST v1 API, explicit approval review, integration readiness checks, and evidence-first verification. The package includes a small optional REST CLI for an existing authorized Nexus endpoint. It does not bundle a hosted model, credentials, or an MCP server, and it never grants filesystem, GitHub, deployment, browser, or infrastructure permissions by itself.
capabilities: Plan missions with explicit capability and tool requirements
Plan isolated Nexus projects and Guardian permissions
Run and inspect authorized Guardian tasks
Assess Lucio, Ember, Nexus Code, Railway, and Supabase integration readiness
Audit verification, tenant isolation, and production readiness
defaultPrompt: Plan this mission with Nexus Starship Guardians and show the selected Guardians and required tools.
Inspect my Nexus run and explain any pending approvals.
Review whether this Nexus integration has enough evidence for release.
